title: Defeating Git Rigour Fatigue with Jujutsu
summary: This article explores Jujutsu (jj), a Rust-based version control system designed as a modern alternative to Git that simplifies distributed version control workflows and reduces the cognitive overhead of managing complex git histories.
problem_solved: Addresses Git's steep learning curve and complexity fatigue that makes version control unintuitive for developers.
why_valuable: Jujutsu provides a cleaner, more predictable VCS experience with first-class features like auto-rebase and virtual branches that Git lacks, making daily version control tasks less error-prone.
